claims.claim: Draftinging AI provides a browser-based, human-in-the-loop workflow tool where lets ops/CX teams define email-triggered workflows where AI drafts actions and a human reviews/completes them

excerpts.excerpt: Workflows have a trigger and an action

claims.claim: The product supports incremental/partial automation, starting with AI handling a few workflow steps and handing off to a human, expanding scope over time

excerpts.excerpt: With partial automation, we suggest starting to automate a workflow by configuring the AI to do just the first few, well defined steps, then handing off to a person to finish.

claims.claim: The AI is trained to use the same tools/UI as a human (browser-based automation), avoiding replatforming as automation scope grows

excerpts.excerpt: Because the AI is being trained to use the same tools as a person, there's no replatforming or rework as you grow it towards full automation.

claims.claim: The company's Show HN launch post received 29 points and 2 comments on Hacker News

sources.title: Show HN: Drafting AI – Human-in-the-loop AI automation for ops teams' email
